description: This file defines the AppFactory class within the Slim framework, responsible for creating and configuring instances of the Slim App. It manages dependencies such as response, stream, container, route, and middleware factories, and provides methods for setting up the application with various configurations and dependency injections.

classes.name: AppFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and configuring Slim App instances with dependency management and setup methods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Slim App instance with optional dependency overrides.

methods.name: createFromContainer
methods.description: Creates a Slim App instance using provided container, resolving dependencies from it.

methods.name: determineResponseFactory
methods.description: Detects and returns an appropriate PSR-17 ResponseFactory, throwing an exception if none are found.

methods.name: attemptResponseFactoryDecoration
methods.description: Wraps the response factory with a decorator if Slim's HTTP decorators are enabled and available.

methods.name: setPsr17FactoryProvider
methods.description: Sets the PSR-17 factory provider instance.

methods.name: setCallableResolver
methods.description: Sets the resolver for callables within the application.

methods.name: setSlimHttpDecoratorsAutomaticDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic detection of Slim HTTP decorators.
